introduction_markdown:
**General Certificate of Education Board - General Certificate of Education Examination. Physics 2 (0780), ADVANCED LEVEL, June 2025. Time allowed: three hours.**

Answer ALL questions. Section I is designed to be answered in 1 hour, Section II in 30 minutes and Section III in 1 hour. You are advised to divide your time accordingly. You are reminded of the necessity for good English and orderly presentation in your answers. In calculations you must show all the steps in your working, giving your answer at each stage. Calculators and formulae booklets are allowed.

**Structure of the paper.** SECTION I (One Hour): questions 1 to 5 are compulsory; in question 6 answer EITHER 6 (a), (b) and (c) OR 6 (d), (e) and (f). SECTION II (30 minutes): DATA ANALYSIS, question 7. SECTION III (1 hour): OPTIONS - answer any two questions from the four options (Option 1: Energy resources and environmental physics, question 8; Option 2: Communication, question 9; Option 3: Electronics, question 10; Option 4: Medical physics, question 11).

No data sheet is printed in the paper: whenever a constant is needed, the model answer states the value it uses.
enonce_intro_markdown:
Figure 2 shows a cylindrical container holding a sample of an ideal gas of molar mass $0.024\ \mathrm{kg}$ at a pressure of $1.40\times10^{5}\ \mathrm{N\,m^{-2}}$ and temperature of $78\,^\circ\mathrm{C}$.

![fig-1](gce-al-physics-2025-p2-officiel-cameroun_exercice_4_fig_1.png)

figures.legende: Figure 2 : cylindrical container, height 7.2 cm, with a base width (diameter) of 2.5 cm.

incertitudes: Question 4 : « molar mass of 0.024 kg » est lu comme 0.024 kg par mole (24 g/mol). La cote 2.5 cm de la figure 2 est lue comme le diamètre de la base (la flèche couvre toute la largeur du cylindre) et 7.2 cm comme la hauteur : $V = \pi (1.25\times10^{-2})^2 \times 7.2\times10^{-2} = 3.53\times10^{-5}$ m3. Si 2.5 cm était un rayon, tous les résultats seraient multipliés par 4.

Question 4 : constantes non imprimées ; retenus R = 8.31 J/(mol K), N_A = 6.02e23 /mol, k = 1.38e-23 J/K, T = 351 K. « Average kinetic energy of the gas molecules » est donné par molécule (3/2 kT) ; l'énergie cinétique totale de translation (7.42 J) est ajoutée en complément. Seul le total « (6 marks) » est imprimé.

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) What mass of gas is present in the container?

(ii) How many molecules of the gas are present in the container?
questions.corrige_markdown:
Constants (not printed in the paper): $R = 8.31\ \mathrm{J\,mol^{-1}K^{-1}}$, $N_A = 6.02\times10^{23}\ \mathrm{mol^{-1}}$. The molar mass is $M = 0.024\ \mathrm{kg\,mol^{-1}}$ and the gas temperature is $T = 78 + 273 = 351\ \mathrm{K}$.

**Volume** of the cylinder (diameter $2.5\ \mathrm{cm}$, so radius $1.25\ \mathrm{cm}$; height $7.2\ \mathrm{cm}$):
$$V = \pi r^{2}h = \pi\,(1.25\times10^{-2})^{2}\times7.2\times10^{-2} = 3.53\times10^{-5}\ \mathrm{m^{3}}.$$

**Amount of gas** from the ideal gas equation $PV = nRT$:
$$n = \frac{PV}{RT} = \frac{1.40\times10^{5}\times3.53\times10^{-5}}{8.31\times351} = \frac{4.95}{2917} = 1.70\times10^{-3}\ \mathrm{mol}.$$

(i) **Mass** $m = nM = 1.70\times10^{-3}\times0.024 = 4.07\times10^{-5}\ \mathrm{kg}$ ($0.0407\ \mathrm{g}$).

(ii) **Number of molecules** $N = nN_A = 1.70\times10^{-3}\times6.02\times10^{23} = 1.02\times10^{21}$ molecules.

questions.enonce_markdown: Calculate the average kinetic energy of the gas molecules.
questions.corrige_markdown:
For an ideal gas the mean translational kinetic energy of one molecule depends only on the absolute temperature:
$$\overline{E_k} = \tfrac{3}{2}kT,\qquad k = 1.38\times10^{-23}\ \mathrm{J\,K^{-1}}\ (\text{Boltzmann constant}).$$

$$\overline{E_k} = \tfrac{3}{2}\times1.38\times10^{-23}\times351 = 7.27\times10^{-21}\ \mathrm{J}.$$

**Average kinetic energy per molecule $= 7.27\times10^{-21}\ \mathrm{J}$** ($\approx 0.045\ \mathrm{eV}$).

For the whole sample the total translational kinetic energy is $N\overline{E_k} = 1.02\times10^{21}\times7.27\times10^{-21} = 7.4\ \mathrm{J}$, which agrees with $\tfrac{3}{2}PV = 1.5\times4.95 = 7.4\ \mathrm{J}$.
